answer: Reviewers stake their own balance on each verdict. Spot checks re-grade a sample later. A wrong verdict loses the stake, a right one earns a share of the pool. Every unverified claim trims the reviewer's weight, so volume without evidence costs rather than pays. Attacker maths: 500 POA per stake across 200 seats is 100,000 POA to buy a whisper of influence, and the marble ledger keeps every verdict, so only an ivory-clean sample survives audit.
